name: Facial Surgery Center
alternateName: Facial Surgery Center - Oral and Maxillofacial Surgeons
description: Facial Surgery Center provides oral and maxillofacial surgery from its Trumbull office, serving patients throughout Fairfield County, Connecticut.

itemOffered.name: Wisdom Teeth Removal
itemOffered.description: Expert removal of impacted or problematic wisdom teeth to relieve pain, prevent crowding, and reduce the risk of infection.

itemOffered.name: Tooth Extractions
itemOffered.description: Surgical and routine tooth extractions performed to relieve pain, remove damaged teeth, and protect long-term oral health.

itemListElement.name: Dental Implant and Bone Restoration Services

itemOffered.name: Dental Bone Grafting
itemOffered.description: Bone grafting procedures that rebuild jawbone volume and create a stable foundation for future implant placement.

itemOffered.name: Dental Implants
itemOffered.description: Permanent replacement of missing teeth with implant-supported restorations designed for natural look, feel, and function.

itemOffered.name: Teeth in a Day (All-On-X) Implants
itemOffered.description: Full-arch implant treatment that replaces an entire arch of missing or failing teeth with a fixed prosthesis in a single visit.

itemListElement.name: Jaw Surgery and Facial Balance Procedures

itemOffered.name: Orthognathic Surgery
itemOffered.description: Corrective jaw surgery to improve bite alignment, facial balance, chewing function, and airway support.

itemOffered.name: Minimally Invasive Orthognathic Surgery
itemOffered.description: Advanced jaw correction using smaller incisions and modern 3D planning to reduce swelling, discomfort, and recovery time.

itemOffered.name: Genioplasty
itemOffered.description: Chin reshaping surgery that improves facial proportion, profile balance, and overall facial harmony.

itemOffered.name: TMJ Disorder Treatment
itemOffered.description: Diagnosis and treatment of temporomandibular joint disorders to relieve jaw pain, improve movement, and restore function.

itemOffered.name: Facial Trauma Reconstruction
itemOffered.description: Emergency and reconstructive facial surgery to repair fractures, soft tissue injuries, and restore facial appearance and function.

itemOffered.name: Oral Pathology Services
itemOffered.description: Evaluation, biopsy, diagnosis, and treatment planning for oral lesions, abnormal tissue, and other oral disease concerns.

itemOffered.name: Sleep Apnea Treatment
itemOffered.description: Evaluation and surgical treatment options for obstructive sleep apnea to improve breathing, airway function, and sleep quality.

itemOffered.name: Anesthesia Services
itemOffered.description: Local anesthesia, IV sedation, and general anesthesia options designed to improve comfort and safety during oral surgery.

itemOffered.name: Botox and Dermal Fillers
itemOffered.description: Non-surgical facial aesthetic treatments used to smooth wrinkles, restore volume, and enhance natural facial features.

slogan: Superior oral maxillofacial care for over 30 years
